_comment: Regression fixture for an empty required_types. Against wildcard-scope-model.json, `user` and `national_calendar` are bare types with no relations block at all; `diocesan_calendar` has admin/editor/viewer. required_types is declared as an empty array here, not omitted. Before the fix, requirementScope's `has("required_types")` branch treated a present-but-empty list as the scope itself, so the "*" wildcard below resolved to [] and required_relations checked nothing, reporting satisfied. After the fix, an empty list falls back to the whole model, so user and national_calendar are in scope and both violate the wildcard's "admin" requirement.
